lines.1: 「I told you not to call me by my name, you morooooon!」
lines.3: 「Sorry. I got it wrong on purpose.」
lines.4: 「...You have wounded me deeply... You sullied the heart of an innocent little angel. How are you going to take responsibility as a human being?」
lines.5: 「To be specific, only a plate of curry can fill the hole in my heart.」
lines.6: She was just trying to mooch a meal off me.
